rows.basis: Riot says it is buying development land near Corsicana and adding fiber and water to make the site more attractive, and its MD&A says part of the $148.4m land purchase was land intended for data center development. No AI or data-center amount is split out of consolidated capex of $201.4m; the Rockdale fit-out for AMD (revenue from January 2026) is not quantified for 2025, and miner purchases ($213.6m of miners and deposits) are excluded.
Forecast capex of $214m over the 18 months from Q3 2025 for two data-center buildings, at $1.9m per critical IT MW. The window spans late 2025 into 2027, so it is not a clean fiscal-2026 figure.

Midpoint of the stated $2.1bn–$2.3bn expected capex for the frontier AI lab lease buildout. It excludes the separately stated ~$81m for the second 25 MW (AMD), which would bring the total to about $2.28bn. Timing across years is not stated.
The MD&A links demand for Engineering-segment products to the growing interest in data center construction and to power demand. Engineering revenue is not split by end market, and AI is not named.

The MD&A links third-party demand for Engineering products ($94.4m segment revenue) to data center construction and power demand. There is no AI or data-center split; Bitcoin Mining ($576.3m) is excluded. The 10-K has no data center segment for 2025.
